notes: Fix: map background was blank; the old map tile service (CARTO) now needs a key, so the map now uses OpenStreetMap tiles, shown dark to match the app
Map resizes correctly after rotating the phone or switching tabs
Map: ROUTE with number pad (last ZIP is selected so typing replaces it), tappable Active ZIPs with counts, same rule for counts and the route, and a list of who was left out and why

Map: ROUTE ALL (every Active pin) and Route selected (search, tick, Include all, Paste names with close-spelling matching); routes open Google Maps in parts of 10 stops; single stops can open Apple Maps
Map: search highlights and zooms to a person; tapping a pin shows a name card with a small person icon to open the profile
Map: gold ring on pins run today (since midnight)
Map: DAILY RUN with numbered markers, path line and Runs list; Last 12h / Yesterday / ◀ ▶ day selector; opens on the latest day with runs when the last 12 hours are empty
Addresses: several per profile with confirmation status and colored chip (Current, Moved, Unconfirmed, Fake, Abandoned), short note, primary, auto-filled ZIP (Census, then OpenStreetMap)
Phones: several per profile with type (Confirmed, Relative, Spouse, Disconnected, Old Number), name note and primary
Profile: birthday, reason speculated, language, employer and hours, linked profiles (up to 3), Roaches status
Cards: EPO, Paid In, amount due, Total RV; resolution note; resolved cards show days past due when resolved; Resolved history
Files: photos per profile (ID, Lease, Income, Other) stored on the phone, with viewer and delete; included in backups
"Is this the same person?" check when creating a profile or changing a name, phone or address
Active list layout: 1 or 2 columns (Settings, default 2); 2-column cards keep names on one line and shrink to fit; quick view spans both columns
Quick view: addresses (tap for directions), phones, cards, last run line, Open profile and Log run
Run History: "Last run" summary line, tap to expand, delete a run; runs are saved before Messages opens
Trackers tab: cards charging off by month with Total RV
Works when hosted in a subfolder (e.g. GitHub Pages)
First iOS version (web app for iPhone, add to Home Screen).
Active list sorted like Android: pinned, FPD, SPD, then furthest past due.
Profiles with addresses (Apple/Google Maps), phones (call/text), status, notes and agreement cards.
Per-card Resolved with reasons, including Returned and Company $50 payoff.
Charged off (previous month + A-Z) and Resolved lists.
Run quick-log buttons (N/A, N/A LDT, Answered, Note) that log to Run History and open Messages.
Map of pins (needs internet).
Backup export/import in Settings. Works offline.
